summary: Suncor Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 14, 2026, attaching its Extractive Sector Transparency Measures Act report for fiscal year 2025. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure required under Canadian law, detailing payments made to governments in the mining, oil and gas sectors. It includes no transaction, no change in control, no shareholder vote, and no special event. The document is a non-substantive compliance filing with no impact on corporate structure or securities. No analysis of special-situation elements is warranted.
